customer_name: North China Electric Power University (华北电力大学)
business_problem: North China Electric Power University wanted a general campus assistant that could answer everyday questions, guide users into the right business systems, and do so securely on university-controlled infrastructure without exposing sensitive institutional data.
solution_summary: North China Electric Power University built the 'i Huadian' assistant with Baidu AI Cloud as a campus-wide service for students and staff. The implementation combines Qianfan AppBuilder with a 'ERNIE 4.0 + Super Assistant' pattern: a very large model handles deep understanding and response generation, while a smaller intent-recognition model helps route users to the right business application or answer path. The assistant supports multi-turn dialogue for everyday needs such as checking notices, phone numbers, workflows, courses, meal-card top-ups, library borrowing, and document lookup. Just as importantly, the service was designed for controlled deployment: the Super Assistant's core application services run in a private on-premises machine room so institutional data stays inside a protected environment while operating cost remains manageable. The result is a conversational front door that links fragmented campus systems into one secure and easier-to-use experience.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports the assembly of the university's campus-assistant application and service logic.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying large-model capability for broad campus question answering and service generation.

solution_components.name: ERNIE 4.0 + Super Assistant Solution
solution_components.role: Handles complex understanding and response generation for the campus-wide AI assistant experience.

solution_components.name: Intent Recognition Small Model
solution_components.role: Detects user intent precisely so the assistant can push the right campus application entry points.

solution_components.name: Private On-premises Deployment
solution_components.role: Keeps the assistant's core services and data inside the university's own protected machine-room environment.

data_flow: Campus notices, guides, workflows, and application-entry data are connected to the assistant, where Qianfan and ERNIE provide broad language understanding while a smaller model routes intent. Users ask questions in natural language, the assistant returns answers or pushes the right business-system entry point, and the full interaction remains inside the university's private deployment environment.
business_outcome: The university gained a single conversational entry point for many campus services, improved the usability of existing systems, and protected sensitive data through private deployment instead of relying on a fully public AI service model.
architecture_clues: The assistant uses a large-plus-small-model pattern, with a large model for depth and a smaller model for intent routing.
Private machine-room deployment is central to the solution's security and cost design.
The assistant is intended to push users directly into campus applications rather than only answer questions in chat.
evidence_quotes: The university built the 'i Huadian' assistant on Qianfan AppBuilder to support notices, workflows, courses, meal-card top-ups, and library queries (original: 基于千帆AppBuilder，打造AI助手"i华电"…涵盖查课程、充饭卡、借书籍、查文献等校园生活高频需求).
Baidu proposed an 'ERNIE 4.0 + Super Assistant' solution for the campus assistant (original: 创新性地提出了"文心4.0+超级助理解决方案").
The assistant combines a thousand-billion-parameter large model with a hundred-billion small model for intent recognition (original: 它采用了千亿级别的文心大模型进行深度服务，同时结合百亿级别的小模型进行精准的意图识别).
Core application services are deployed in a local private machine room to protect all data and reduce large-model privatization cost (original: 超级助理的核心应用服务被部署在本地私有化的机房中，所有数据都受到严格保护).
